summary: The Tourist earlier quest filler is missing from the JavaScript special-level loader. On quest Home level 2, mklev.c:makelevel selects Tou-fila and passes it through makemaz/load_special; js/mklev.js computes the same name but SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS has no Tou-fila entry, so generation falls through to an ordinary level. Port the complete dat/Tou-fila.lua program and register it in the quest-level loader.

source.branch: When the hero is in the Tourist quest on a level above the locate level, makelevel selects the earlier filler program Tou-fila.lua.
dependencies: sp_lev.c level descriptor APIs already implemented by js/mklev.js

evidence: challenges/manifests/v62.json identifies the mission as dat/Tou-fila.lua, records the C source trace through mklev.c:makelevel, and states that js/mklev.js:makelevel computes the fill name but the registry lacks Tou-fila.

nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:1251-1285 selects <filecode>-fila above the role locate level; nethack-c/upstream/dat/Tou-fila.lua defines a complete mines-style filler with flags, stairs, objects, traps, and hostile soldiers/monster classes.

js/mklev.js:759-772 computes Tou-fila for the reproduced Tourist Home level 2 and proceeds to ordinary generation when SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS lacks the name; js/quest_levels.js exports the registry containing other role filler programs but no Tou-fila.

The admitted v62 evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-d5dbdd91320c86b9ba2ad0b396dfb8122eea8e84-v62.json at d5dbdd91320c86b9ba2ad0b396dfb8122eea8e84 records 299/328 screens, 9417/12218 RNG calls, and 306/328 cursors matched; the case C observation shows the distinct generated level after the missing loader branch.

The queue annotation names nhlib.lua because load_special performs its existing alignment initialization; the manifest source trace and C selector establish Tou-fila.lua as the missing program that owns the mismatch.

Current worker base edf67a990329752517ee8ba0204f6b4aab593d1f was replayed with runJsSession against the admitted C recording; .cache/A2-tourist-earlier-baseline.json records the first screen/RNG/cursor mismatch at segment 0 step 299, including C rn2(3) in nhlib.lua:8 shuffle versus JS rn2(5) from ordinary level generation.
